# @usdctofiat/offramp v8

USDC-to-fiat cash-out SDK for Base. `cashout()` is the golden path and requires an explicit `fast` or `best` mode. Cash-outs are observable through Peerlytics explorer/data surfaces.

## Install

bun add @usdctofiat/offramp

## API

```ts
import {
  cashout,
  OFFRAMP_DEVELOPER_RESOURCES,
  OFFRAMP_RESOURCE_LINKS,
  OFFRAMP_INTEGRATION_PLAYBOOKS,
  getOfframpDeveloperResources,
} from "@usdctofiat/offramp";

// Direct Peer Cash route at the live oracle rate (0 bps spread)
const result = await cashout({
  mode: "fast",
  signer: walletClient,
  amount: "100",
  platform: "revolut",
  currency: "EUR",
  payee: "alice",
});
// Persist result.depositId immediately; it is the cross-process resume key.

// Delegate-managed pricing (10 bps fill fee)
const best = await cashout({
  mode: "best",
  signer: walletClient,
  amount: "100",
  platform: "revolut",
  currency: "EUR",
  payee: "alice",
});

// Rail kill-switch: drop platforms from discovery and reject them before any
// new deposit. Cash App ships disabled by default in OFFRAMP_DISABLED_PAYMENT_PLATFORMS.
const gated = await cashout({
  mode: "fast",
  signer: walletClient,
  amount: "100",
  platform: "revolut",
  currency: "EUR",
  payee: "alice",
  disabledPlatforms: ["cashapp"],
});

// Canonical resources for apps, bots, agents, OTC, and Peerlytics
console.log(OFFRAMP_DEVELOPER_RESOURCES.links.sdkGuide);
console.log(OFFRAMP_RESOURCE_LINKS.agentSkill);
console.log(OFFRAMP_INTEGRATION_PLAYBOOKS.map((entry) => entry.profile));
console.log(getOfframpDeveloperResources("agent"));
```

`cashout()` accepts a human USDC amount as a string or number, or exact six-decimal base units as a bigint. The v8 flat helper is production-only and always requires `mode`.

## Managed v5 compatibility

Use the old managed EscrowV2 helpers only when maintaining a v5-shaped flow:

```ts
import {
  close,
  deposits,
  disableOtc,
  enableOtc,
  getOtcLink,
} from "@usdctofiat/offramp";

// Retrofit OTC onto an existing deposit
await enableOtc(walletClient, "362", "0xTakerAddress");
const link = getOtcLink("362");

// Make a deposit public again. The options argument is required in v9; leave it
// empty and the SDK resolves the exact payment-method set from ProtocolViewer.
await disableOtc(walletClient, "362", {});

// List deposits (read-only)
const list = await deposits("0x...");

// Close deposit
await close(walletClient, "362");
```

## Resource bundle

`OFFRAMP_DEVELOPER_RESOURCES` includes:
- packageName, sdkVersion, Base chain metadata, ERC-8021 attribution codes
- mandatory delegation config (`rateManagerId`, registry address, manager fee bps, escrow)
- links: developerPortal, sdkGuide, appGuide, botGuide, agentGuide, privateOtcGuide, peerlyticsGuide, agentSkill, llms references, starters, Peerlytics, npm
- playbooks for `app`, `bot`, `agent`, `private-otc`, and `peerlytics`

Use `getOfframpDeveloperResources(profile)` to retrieve one playbook. Valid profiles: `app`, `bot`, `agent`, `private-otc`, `peerlytics`.

## PLATFORMS constant

```ts
PLATFORMS.REVOLUT.id            // "revolut"
PLATFORMS.REVOLUT.name          // "Revolut"
PLATFORMS.REVOLUT.currencies    // ["AED", "AUD", "CAD", ..., "USD", "ZAR"]
PLATFORMS.REVOLUT.identifier    // { label: "Revtag", placeholder: "revtag (no @)", help: "Revtag without @ (must be public)" }
PLATFORMS.REVOLUT.validate("@alice")  // { valid: true, normalized: "alice" }

// PayPal uses paypal.me USERNAMES now, not emails (v2 BREAKING):
PLATFORMS.PAYPAL.identifier     // { label: "PayPal.me Username", placeholder: "paypal.me/your-username", help: "Your PayPal.me username, not your email" }
PLATFORMS.PAYPAL.validate("https://paypal.me/Alice")  // { valid: true, normalized: "alice" }

// Extension-registration metadata (PayPal, Wise, Venmo, Cash App):
PLATFORMS.PAYPAL.extensionRegistration
// { providerId: "paypal", requiredPrompt: "This PayPal username is not registered yet...", ctaLabel: "Register PayPal Username", ctaSubtext: "PayPal Business accounts are not supported at this time." }
PLATFORMS.VENMO.extensionRegistration
// { providerId: "venmo", requiredPrompt: "This Venmo username is not registered yet...", ctaLabel: "Register Venmo Username" }
PLATFORMS.CASHAPP.extensionRegistration
// { providerId: "cashapp", requiredPrompt: "This Cash App cashtag is not registered yet...", ctaLabel: "Register Cash App Cashtag" }
```

Keys: VENMO, CASHAPP, CHIME, REVOLUT, WISE, MERCADO_PAGO, ZELLE, PAYPAL, MONZO

## CURRENCIES constant

```ts
CURRENCIES.EUR.code        // "EUR"
CURRENCIES.EUR.name        // "Euro"
CURRENCIES.EUR.symbol      // "€"
CURRENCIES.EUR.countryCode // "eu"
```

34 currencies: AED, ARS, AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CNY, CZK, DKK, EUR, GBP, HKD, HUF, IDR, ILS, INR, JPY, KES, MXN, MYR, NOK, NZD, PHP, PLN, RON, SAR, SEK, SGD, THB, TRY, UGX, USD, VND, ZAR

## Managed compatibility: React hooks

```ts
import { useOfframp, usePeerExtensionRegistration } from "@usdctofiat/offramp/react";

const {
  offramp, deposits, close,
  state, step, txHash, depositId,
  lastError, isLoading, reset,
} = useOfframp({ integratorId: "your-app", referralId: "partner-123" });
// state: "idle" | "approving" | "registering" | "depositing" | "confirming" | "delegating" | "done" | "error"
// step:  granular OfframpStep (also includes "resuming", "restricting" and "protecting" — `state` collapses those into "delegating")
// lastError: OfframpError | null — has .code, .step, .txHash, .depositId, .cause
// (`error` is also returned for legacy callers but is deprecated — use `lastError`.)

// Extension-gated seller registration driver:
const peer = usePeerExtensionRegistration(PLATFORMS.PAYPAL);
// { phase, info, busy, error, capturedMetadata, refresh, installExtension,
//   connectExtension, startRegistrationCapture, completeRegistration }
// phase: "checking" | "needs_install" | "needs_connection" | "ready" | "unsupported"
// startRegistrationCapture() launches headless metadata capture; once
//   capturedMetadata.sarCredentialCapture.credentialBundle is set, call
//   completeRegistration(walletClient, params) to upload + retry in one shot.
// (openVerifySidebar() is a deprecated alias of startRegistrationCapture().)
```

## Managed compatibility: types

```ts
interface OfframpParams {
  amount: string;            // USDC decimal, min 1
  platform: PlatformEntry;   // PLATFORMS.REVOLUT etc
  currency: CurrencyEntry;   // CURRENCIES.EUR etc
  identifier: string;        // platform-specific (PayPal is paypal.me USERNAME, not email)
  otcTaker?: string;         // recovery only: restrict an EXISTING undelegated deposit; fresh creation fails UNSUPPORTED
  disabledPlatforms?: string[]; // host rollout kill-switch, canonical platform ids
  integratorId?: string;     // ERC-8021 attribution (telemetry)
  referralId?: string;       // optional partner referral code (telemetry)
  idempotencyKey?: string;   // per-wallet replay key, replays the first successful result for 10 minutes
}

interface OfframpResult {
  depositId: string;
  txHash: string;
  resumed: boolean;  // true if existing undelegated deposit was resumed
  otcLink?: string;  // present only when otcTaker recovery restricted the deposit
}

interface EnableOtcResult {
  depositId: string;
  takerAddress: string;
  otcLink: string;
}

type OfframpStep =
  | "approving"
  | "registering"
  | "depositing"
  | "confirming"
  | "protecting"   // managed flow reconciling dispute protection before delegation
  | "delegating"
  | "restricting"  // only during otcTaker recovery of an existing deposit
  | "resuming"
  | "done";

interface DepositInfo {
  depositId: string;       // pass to close()
  compositeId: string;     // escrowAddress_depositId
  txHash?: string;
  status: "active" | "empty" | "closed";
  remainingUsdc: number;
  outstandingUsdc: number;
  totalTakenUsdc: number;
  fulfilledIntents: number;
  paymentMethods: string[];
  currencies: string[];
  rateSource: string;      // pricing-mode tag from the indexer (e.g. "track_market", "fixed"); "unknown" when missing
  delegated: boolean;
  escrowAddress: string;
}
```

## Managed compatibility: errors

```ts
import { OfframpError, OFFRAMP_ERROR_CODES } from "@usdctofiat/offramp";
// error.code values:
//   VALIDATION
//   APPROVAL_FAILED
//   REGISTRATION_FAILED
//   EXTENSION_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED   // PeerAuth seller registration gate
//   DEPOSIT_FAILED
//   CONFIRMATION_FAILED
//   DELEGATION_FAILED
//   USER_CANCELLED
//   UNSUPPORTED
// error.step, error.txHash, error.depositId
```

For the managed compatibility flow, call `offramp()` again to detect and resume an undelegated deposit.

`EXTENSION_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED` recovery: walk the user through
`usePeerExtensionRegistration(platform)` (React) or `peerExtensionSdk` directly
(see the managed Peer Extension section below), then call the compatibility `offramp()` helper with the same handle.

## Managed compatibility: Peer Extension (PayPal, Wise, Venmo, Cash App)

PayPal, Wise, Venmo, and Cash App makers may need to register their handle
inside the PeerAuth browser extension before curator's `/v2/makers/create`
accepts them. The managed compatibility `offramp()` helper throws `OfframpError` with code
`EXTENSION_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED` when this happens. The SDK re-exports the
driver from `@zkp2p/sdk` so you don't need a direct dep on it:

```ts
import {
  peerExtensionSdk,
  getPeerExtensionRegistrationAuthParams,
  completePeerExtensionRegistration,
} from "@usdctofiat/offramp";

const state = await peerExtensionSdk.getState();
// "needs_install" | "needs_connection" | "ready"

if (state === "needs_install") peerExtensionSdk.openInstallPage();
else if (state === "needs_connection") await peerExtensionSdk.requestConnection();
else {
  // Headless metadata capture:
  const params = getPeerExtensionRegistrationAuthParams("paypal");
  const unsubscribe = peerExtensionSdk.onMetadataMessage(async (message) => {
    if (message.platform !== params.platform) return;
    if (!message.sarCredentialCapture?.credentialBundle) return;
    await completePeerExtensionRegistration({
      platform: PLATFORMS.PAYPAL,
      identifier: "alicepay",
      capturedMetadata: message,
    });
    // then retry the managed compatibility flow with the same handle
  });
  peerExtensionSdk.authenticate(params);
}
```

React wrapper:

```tsx
import { PLATFORMS, OFFRAMP_ERROR_CODES } from "@usdctofiat/offramp";
import { useOfframp, usePeerExtensionRegistration } from "@usdctofiat/offramp/react";

const { offramp, lastError } = useOfframp();
const peer = usePeerExtensionRegistration(PLATFORMS.PAYPAL);

const needsExt = lastError?.code === OFFRAMP_ERROR_CODES.EXTENSION_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED;
// peer.phase-aware CTAs:
//   peer.phase === "needs_install"    → peer.installExtension()
//   peer.phase === "needs_connection" → peer.connectExtension()
//   peer.phase === "ready"            → peer.startRegistrationCapture()
// When peer.capturedMetadata.sarCredentialCapture.credentialBundle is set:
//   peer.completeRegistration(walletClient, params)  (uploads + retries deposit)
// Or after the user confirms: retry the managed flow with the same identifier.
```

Check `platform.extensionRegistration` to decide whether to surface a PeerAuth
CTA. PayPal, Wise, Venmo, and Cash App currently ship that metadata.

See `usdctofiat/paypal-react-example.tsx` and `usdctofiat/paypal-deposit.ts`.

## Peer Extension direct driver

If you use the re-exported `peerExtensionSdk` directly, capture runs through
the headless metadata bridge: register `onMetadataMessage(callback)`, then call
`authenticate({ actionType, captureMode, platform, providerConfig })`. Re-run
`authenticate` if the active capture callback is missed.

## Managed compatibility flow

The compatibility `offramp()` helper is resumable. Before creating a new deposit it checks for an existing undelegated deposit and, if found, skips to delegation.

Full flow (3 wallet signatures — 4 during `otcTaker` recovery of an existing deposit):
1. Approve USDC allowance (wallet tx)
2. Register payee details (`POST /v2/makers/create` — flat `{ offchainId, telegramUsername? }` payload)
3. Create deposit on-chain (wallet tx)
4. Confirm deposit ID (automatic, no signature)
5. Delegate to vault (wallet tx)
6. Restrict to OTC taker (wallet tx, only during `otcTaker` recovery)

All deposits are delegated, market-tracking, auto-closing, on Base (8453).

## OTC private orders

v9 rejects `otcTaker` on fresh creation. The protocol cannot yet create a deposit paused and private atomically, so a one-call private order would leave a public window open between creation and restriction; passing it to a new cash-out fails `UNSUPPORTED`. The option survives only to recover an exact existing undelegated deposit, which the SDK pauses, reconciles, reopens, and delegates in order.

Create the deposit, let it confirm, then restrict it with `enableOtc(walletClient, depositId, takerAddress)`. Reopen it with `disableOtc(walletClient, depositId, {})`. Both helpers derive the deposit-wide direct-taker set from a freshness-gated canonical index projection and fail before cleanup when that projection is stale, partial, or contradictory. Hand the returned `otcLink` or the `getOtcLink(depositId)` result to the buyer.
